findings.message: One operator moves a large coral sale block through multiple clear stations, and the remaining block visibly shrinks, so the cost-subtraction sequence is legible.
No buyer decision is depicted; the contract centers on cost subtraction rather than purchase choice.
The image relies on an abstract tabletop business metaphor with staged blocks and a single operator, which slightly drifts toward conceptual proxy evidence.

successfulRequirements: No readable text, logos, UI, or watermark present.
One human operator is visible and actively moving the sale token.
Distinct sequential stations are visible across depth.
A visibly smaller retained remainder is present in the output tray.
Cause-and-effect between stations and reduction is clear without narration.
